snippet.title: exA-Arcadia『ブレイカーズリベンジ死嘩護』| BREAKERS REVENGE CHICAGO for Arcades | Attract Video
snippet.description:
BREAKERS REVENGE CHICAGO for Arcades on exA-Arcadia
Available Now

Players: 1-2
Genre: Fighter
Monitor: Horizontal (Recommended), Vertical
Languages: English, Japanese

FEATURES

10 PLAYABLE CHARACTERS
All of your favorite fighting types from grapplers to zoners are here! The last boss Bai-Hu joins the fray as a revamped and rebalanced character!

3 PLAY STYLES
REVENGE – plays exactly the same as BREAKERS REVENGE
EXTRA! – Deal more damage with advanced techniques like chain combos and instantly recover from hit or guard stun with the Revenge Recovery. Use guard push back to get out of sticky situations and cancel KOs with the Dead Revenge technique.
CHICAGO – a rebalanced play mode with the ability to now short hop and aggressively go after the opponent

0.3 FRAME INPUT LAG RESPONSE – more than three times as fast as the original version
Maximum Performance! Play like you’re meant to. Never miss a combo again.

2 SOUNDTRACKS
ORIGINAL – the original high quality Neo Geo CD soundtrack sampled from the master
ARRANGED – the new acclaimed arranged soundtrack composed by Kenichi Kamio

NEW GRAPHICS
Illustrated by manga master, Motoki Yoshihara, each character is lovingly detailed in new in game and wallpaper artwork

NEW SYSTEM VOICE
A new announcer voice has been added to give that extra impact for every match.

LEARN MORE ➡️ https://bit.ly/3wSiFal
SUBSCRIBE ➡️ https://www.youtube.com/@exa-arcadia?view_as=subscriber?Sub_Confirmation=1
